verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
The pure in heart see Your face
All I want is to be with You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Let my heart be like Eden inside
Set apart as a pure and spotless bride
Let my heart be like Eden inside
A place where You can dwell in me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Search me, God, and know my heart
Lead me in the way everlasting

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I’m a garden enclosed
I’m set apart for You

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Search me, God, and know my heart
All I want is to be with You

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Make me a garden enclosed
Set apart for You
